title: Courtland Sutton unconcerned with who is Broncos No. 1 receiver after Jaylen Waddle's arrival

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Courtland Sutton unconcerned with who is Broncos No. 1 receiver after Jaylen Waddle's arrival
sources.description: There was no doubt about Courtland Sutton's placement in the pecking order of Broncos receivers in 2025, but the team's biggest offseason move shook up that depth chart.
